SS11.name: 星纹鲷
SS11.form: a deep oval body, a steep forehead, a small mouth, a large eye, a row of evenly spaced luminous pores along the flank
SS11.fins: a spined dorsal fin with even triangular peaks, a slightly forked tail fin
SS11.markings: thin even lines radiating from the eye, a single luminous pore at each line end
SS11.colour: 深蓝底、星线银纹、眼周微光

SS12.name: 陨星鲈
SS12.form: a moderately deep oval body, a large head, a wide mouth, a slightly protruding lower jaw, faceted plates over the nape
SS12.fins: a dorsal fin with a deep notch, a slightly forked tail fin
SS12.markings: a scatter of star-like punctures along the upper flank, a blotch at the base of the tail
SS12.colour: 铁青底、星芒白点、腹侧冷银

SS13.name: 微光鳕
SS13.form: an elongated cylindrical body, a long tapering head, a small mouth with a single barbel, a low continuous dorsal ridge
SS13.fins: a long low dorsal fin, a long anal fin, a rounded tail fin
SS13.markings: a fine line of dim glowing points along the midline, a short seam behind the gill cover
SS13.colour: 冷褐底、微荧青线、腹部霜白

SS14.name: 星屑鰕虎
SS14.form: a small stout body, a large blunt head, a wide mouth, fused pelvic fins forming a disc, a row of tiny luminous specks along the flank
SS14.fins: a dorsal fin split into two parts, a rounded tail fin, pectoral fins with even rays
SS14.markings: a loose row of luminous specks along the flank, a spot on the gill cover
SS14.colour: 砂青底、星屑银点、头部暗纹

SS15.name: 陨砂鳉
SS15.form: a small slender body, a flattened head, an upturned mouth, fine grains fused into a smooth faceted skin
SS15.fins: a short dorsal fin set far back, a rounded tail fin, small pectoral fins
SS15.markings: a fine gravel-like speckling along the flank, a short streak above the eye
SS15.colour: 砂金底、陨灰微粒、眼顶暗线

SS16.name: 幽星鲽
SS16.form: a flattened oval body, both eyes on one side, a small upturned mouth, a low even fringe along the body margin, a row of glowing pits on the eyed side
SS16.fins: a long dorsal fin and anal fin fringing the body, a rounded tail fin
SS16.markings: a line of glowing pits along the eyed side, a faint arc behind the head
SS16.colour: 深褐底、星点微光、鳍缘冷灰

SS17.name: 星尘水母
SS17.form: a wide flat bell with evenly spaced rim lobes, a central disc of fused points, four grouped trailing tentacles
SS17.markings: a broad ring of luminous points just inside the bell rim, faint radial seams
SS17.colour: 墨蓝底、星尘白点、伞心微荧

SS18.name: 陨石鳃
SS18.form: a deep angular body with faceted plates, a large head, a wide mouth, a row of short gill slits, a heavy blunt snout
SS18.fins: a spined dorsal fin with even peaks, a slightly forked tail fin
SS18.markings: a cluster of pitted craters over the gill cover, a single seam at the tail base
SS18.colour: 石黑底、熔铜斑、冷铁高光

SS19.name: 夜辉鳗
SS19.form: a slender ribbon-like body with a diamond cross-section, a small pointed head, a short mouth, a row of minute luminous nodes down the midline
SS19.fins: a continuous low dorsal ridge merging with the tail fin, small pectoral fins
SS19.markings: a single row of luminous nodes along the flank, a faint break in the ridge behind the head
SS19.colour: 靛夜底、幽辉银点、腹缘冷光

SS20.name: 碎星魟
SS20.form: a broad diamond-shaped disc, wide wing-like pectoral margins, a short tail, a pair of small cephalic horns, a soft forward sweep
SS20.fins: a slender tail with a low dorsal ridge, small pelvic fins
SS20.markings: a scatter of broken luminous fragments across the disc, a fine rim line along the wing edge
SS20.colour: 墨蓝底、碎星银屑、翼缘冷线
